entities.summary: Norair Martirosovich Sisakian (Sissakian) (Armenian: Նորայր Մարտիրոսի Սիսակյան; Russian: Норайр Мартиросович Сисакян, 25 January 1907 – 12 March 1966) was a Soviet biologist of Armenian origin who worked as an engineer in the Soviet space program, working mainly on biomechanics effects. Sisakian is also one of the founders of space biology, an outstanding organizer of science, a member of the Pugwash movement.
